200.Name: sentence-object

201.Name: sentence-with-object

208.Name: dialog-choice-verb
208.Note: Verb id of the dialogue choice being laid out. Each choice in a dialogue script sets it to 500 + n - 1 and builds that verb: 'verb var208 at var594,var256', 'verb var208 name "..."', 'verb var208 on', then records it in var254 (global/script_0142.scumm:113-117, :399-403). 216.Note: Unconfirmed: looks like the object the player last clicked to act on, room object or inventory icon. It is set from var333, the object under the mouse, only in the click handlers: when the action popup opens (global/script_0034.scumm:45, before script 42 starts), on a quick click (global/script_0034.scumm:20 and global/script_0034.scumm:25), when picking from the inventory (global/script_0035.scumm:27), and in global/script_0038.scumm:14 and global/script_0038.scumm:33. global/script_0036.scumm:5-53 runs the popup's chosen verb var215 on it, then clears it at global/script_0036.scumm:56. 254.Name: dialog-choice-verbs
254.Note: Array of the dialogue choice verbs shown, in order: cleared for 0-50 at the start of each menu (global/script_0142.scumm:71-74) and filled with 'var254[var268] = var208' as each choice is laid out (:117, :403).

255.Name: dialog-selected-verb
255.Note: The dialogue choice the player picked, as its verb id (500-539). It is reset to 0 per menu (global/script_0142.scumm:59), and the menu loops 'while (!var255)' (global/script_0142.scumm:64). The dialogue verb-script sets it to the clicked verb (global/script_0013.scumm:29-31). Dialogue scripts then branch on it: 'if (var255 == 500)' ... (global/script_0142.scumm:428-437).

256.Name: dialog-choice-y
256.Note: Y position for the next dialogue choice. Reset to var595 (= 330, global/script_0001.scumm:70) per menu (global/script_0142.scumm:86); each choice is placed with 'verb var208 at var594,var256' and it then grows by var596 (= 24, the line height, global/script_0001.scumm:71) for every line the choice wraps to (global/script_0142.scumm:114, :119-122).

261.Name: cutscene-depth
261.Note: Cutscene nesting depth: global script 1 sets cutscene-start-script = 6 and cutscene-end-script = 7; the engine runs 6 at each cut-scene (var261 + 1, cursor and userput soft-off) and 7 at its end (var261 - 1, back on). Scripts wait while it is non-zero, e.g. Wally in 009_cannon local_2006.

266.Name: item-icon
266.Note: The inventory icon object for an item: each item's verb 91 sets it to its icon, e.g. rooms/009_cannon/objects/0279_ramrod-object.scumm:36 = 122 (0122_ramrod-icon-object) and rooms/001_logo/objects/0100_string-balloon-object.scumm:109/111 = 120 or 119 by class. Global script 2 runs verb 91 just after pick-up-object and loads the icon (global/script_0002.scumm:67-71); script 36 runs it when an item is selected and sets cursor-image (var290) from it (global/script_0036.scumm:10-12). The reverse of icon-item (var300).

268.Name: dialog-choice-count
268.Note: Number of dialogue choices laid out so far in the current menu, and the next index into dialog-choice-verbs (var254): reset to 0 per menu (global/script_0142.scumm:87), used as 'var254[var268] = var208' and incremented after each choice (:117, :123, :403, :409).

290.Name: cursor-image
290.Note: The object whose image is the mouse cursor. Set to system-cursor-icon 105 when nothing is held (global/script_0011.scumm:25-28), system-wait-icon 257 on room exit (global/script_0012.scumm:7-10), an inventory icon when one is picked up (global/script_0035.scumm:33, global/script_0036.scumm:12 = cursor-object) or a door's arrow icon var301 (global/script_0039.scumm:96-99). 82 'cursor image var290' commands; 'var290 != 105' (221x) tests whether something is held.

291.Name: cursor-item
291.Note: The inventory item the cursor stands for, as opposed to its icon (cursor-image). Set alongside var290: = icon-item var300 (global/script_0035.scumm:34), = var216 (global/script_0036.scumm:13), reset to 105 when the cursor empties (global/script_0011.scumm:29). Used as the held item in 'do-sentence 5 var291 with var333' (global/script_0034.scumm:9, :86). Copied into var292 before every change.

292.Name: previous-cursor-item
292.Note: Copy of cursor-item (var291) taken just before the cursor changes: all 223 writes are 'var292 = var291' right before var291 is reassigned (e.g. global/script_0011.scumm:26, global/script_0012.scumm:8, global/script_0039.scumm:97). No script reads it.

300.Name: icon-item
300.Note: The world object an inventory icon stands for. Each icon in room 3 sets it in verb 93, e.g. rooms/003_icons/objects/0122_ramrod-icon-object.scumm:6 var300 = 279 (0279_ramrod-object); 169 such writes, 134 values 100-1340. Callers run 'start-object rec ICON verb 93' then read it: global/script_0035.scumm:29-35 (cursor-item = var300), global/script_0034.scumm:84-86, global/script_0039.scumm:10-16 (owner-of(var300) == ego), :161 (its name in the sentence line).

301.Name: exit-cursor-icon
301.Note: The arrow icon the cursor turns into over an exit. Door objects set it in verb 94, e.g. rooms/009_cannon/objects/0278_cannon-waterline-door.scumm:10 = 106 (west-arrow-icon); values are 106-113 (the eight direction arrows in room 3) and 245/246 (page arrows). global/script_0039.scumm:52-55 sets it for class 156 objects (falling back to 109 south-arrow) and :96-100 makes it the cursor-image.

312.Name: interface-mode
312.Note: Which input mode the interface is in; the click handlers branch on it (global/script_0033.scumm:4-32, global/script_0034.scumm:5/58/124/127, global/script_0035.scumm:4-22). 1 = normal room play (global/script_0001.scumm:195, global/script_0045.scumm:10); 2 = action popup over the room (global/script_0042.scumm:32, started from a room click at global/script_0034.scumm:46); 3 = inventory open (global/script_0046.scumm:11 with bit9); 4 = action popup over the inventory (global/script_0043.scumm:30, started at global/script_0034.scumm:108); 5 = a dialogue menu (rooms/070_famcrypt/local_2003.scumm:68, rooms/081_gondola/local_2005.scumm:33).

315.Name: inventory-page-start
315.Note: Index of the first inventory item on the current inventory page; pages hold (4 + 1) * (2 + 1) = 15 items. global/script_0034.scumm:64-68 adds 15 on the next-page arrow (capped at inventory-count), :74-77 subtracts 15 on the previous one (not below 1). global/script_0067.scumm:4-9 moves it to the last page. Reset to 1 when it passes inventory-count(ego) (global/script_0114.scumm:114-115, 144 'var315 > inventory-count' checks).

329.Name: dialog-choice-silent
329.Note: Array with a flag for each dialogue choice (1-based, local5 = verb - 500 + 1): when it is set, picking that choice skips Guybrush's pose, gesture and say-line (global/script_0013.scumm:20-30). It is cleared for 1-50 at each menu (global/script_0142.scumm:75-79). global/script_0318.scumm:58-62 sets it for every choice. Declared with 'dim int var329[50]' (global/script_0001.scumm:50).

330.Name: dialog-choice-pose
330.Note: Array with a pose for each dialogue choice: when that choice is picked, global/script_0013.scumm:22-23 runs script 106 with it before Guybrush says the line. Its values (15, 18, 20, 24, 26, 27, 29, and 4) are all in script 106's first list, so script 107 changes 'actor 1 talk-animation'. Context, not mentioning var330: global/script_0106.scumm:4-10 gets the value as local0. It is set per choice in dialogue scripts, e.g. global/script_0243.scumm:242 var330[4] = 24, and cleared per menu (global/script_0142.scumm:80-85).

331.Name: dialog-choice-gesture
331.Note: Array with a gesture for each dialogue choice: when that choice is picked, global/script_0013.scumm:25-26 runs script 106 with it after the pose. Its values (9, 10, 11, 30, 31, 34, 35, 38, 39) are not in script 106's first list, so they go to script 108, which plays 'do-animation 1 N' and waits. Context, not mentioning var331: global/script_0106.scumm:11-17 and global/script_0108.scumm:4-17 get the value as local0. It is set per choice, e.g. global/script_0243.scumm:243 var331[4] = 11, and cleared per menu (global/script_0142.scumm:80-85).

594.Name: dialog-choice-x
594.Note: X position of the dialogue choices: set once to 5 (global/script_0001.scumm:69), used in 'verb dialog-choice-verb at var594,dialog-choice-y' (global/script_0142.scumm:114) and to get the text width as 640 - var594 (global/script_0142.scumm:97).

595.Name: dialog-top-y
595.Note: Y position of the first dialogue choice: set once to 330 (global/script_0001.scumm:70) and copied into dialog-choice-y at the start of each menu (global/script_0142.scumm:86).

596.Name: dialog-line-height
596.Note: Height of one line of dialogue choice text: set once to 24 (global/script_0001.scumm:71). dialog-choice-y goes up by it for each line a choice wraps to (global/script_0142.scumm:118-122).

598.Name: dialog-choice-width
598.Note: Pixel width of the dialogue choice being laid out: 'var598 = string-width(1, "...")' with that choice's text (global/script_0142.scumm:96). It is compared with dialog-text-width to work out how many lines the choice wraps to (global/script_0142.scumm:98-103).

599.Name: dialog-text-width
599.Note: Width available for dialogue choice text, 640 - dialog-choice-x (global/script_0142.scumm:97, written 896 times, always like this). Used as the divisor for the number of wrapped lines (global/script_0142.scumm:98-99).

600.Name: dialog-choice-lines
600.Note: Number of lines the dialogue choice being laid out wraps to: dialog-choice-width / dialog-text-width + 1 when it doesn't fit, else 1 (global/script_0142.scumm:98-103). It is added to dialog-lines-used (global/script_0142.scumm:104), sets how far dialog-choice-y moves (global/script_0142.scumm:118-122), and adds its extra lines to dialog-scroll after a scroll down (global/script_0142.scumm:124-125).

601.Name: dialog-line-counter
601.Note: Loop counter over the lines of the dialogue choice just placed: 'var601 = 1; while (var601 <= var600) { dialog-choice-y = dialog-choice-y + var596; var601++ }' (global/script_0142.scumm:118-122). Every write in all 49 scripts is that loop.

602.Name: dialog-lines-used
602.Note: Text lines used by the dialogue choices laid out so far. Reset to 0 per menu (global/script_0142.scumm:89); each choice adds its wrapped line count var600 (worked out from string-width at :96-103) at :104, and past 6 lines dialog-more-below (var603) is set and no more choices are shown (:109-112).

603.Name: dialog-more-below
603.Note: Set when the dialogue menu has more choices than fit: global/script_0142.scumm:109-110 sets it once dialog-lines-used passes 6, and later choices are skipped while it is set (:112). global/script_0014.scumm:10-15 shows the dialog-increment-icon (189) only while it is set. Reset to 0 at each menu (global/script_0142.scumm:61, :91, :422).

604.Name: dialog-scroll
604.Note: How many dialogue choice lines are scrolled off the top of the menu. Reset to 0 per dialogue (global/script_0142.scumm:60). Clicking dialog-decrement-icon 188 subtracts 1 and dialog-increment-icon 189 adds 1 (global/script_0013.scumm:33-41); global/script_0014.scumm:4-9 shows the up arrow only while it is > 0. While laying out, choices are skipped while var605 is below it (global/script_0142.scumm:93-94), and after scrolling down it grows by a skipped choice's extra wrapped lines (:124-125).

605.Name: dialog-lines-skipped
605.Note: Dialogue choice lines skipped so far while laying out a scrolled menu: reset to 0 per menu (global/script_0142.scumm:90), and each choice is skipped and counted with 'var605 = var605 + 1' while dialog-scroll (var604) is greater (:93-94, :130-131).

606.Name: dialog-loop-counter
606.Note: Loop counter in the dialogue menu setup: it turns off verbs 500-539 (global/script_0142.scumm:65-69) and clears dialog-choice-verbs, dialog-choice-silent, dialog-choice-pose and dialog-choice-gesture for entries 0/1-50 (global/script_0142.scumm:70-85). Some rooms use smaller bounds for the same loops: verbs 500-508 and entries 0-8 in rooms/070_famcrypt/local_2003.scumm:72-80.

607.Name: dialog-scrolled-down
607.Note: Set to 1 when the player clicks the dialogue down arrow (dialog-increment-icon 189, global/script_0013.scumm:38-40). For the next layout pass, a skipped choice that wraps over several lines adds its extra lines to dialog-scroll ('else if (var607 == 1) var604 = var604 + (var600 - 1)', global/script_0142.scumm:124-125), so scrolling moves by whole choices; it is cleared after that pass (:417-419).

608.Note: Unconfirmed: the dialog-choice-lines (line count) of the first dialogue choice shown since var609 was last cleared: 'if (!var609) { var609 = 1; var608 = var600 }' (global/script_0142.scumm:105-108). All 896 refs are that write, and no script reads it.

609.Note: Unconfirmed: set to 1 when the first visible dialogue choice is laid out, and var608 then keeps that choice's wrapped line count (global/script_0142.scumm:105-108); cleared when the player scrolls up (global/script_0013.scumm:35-36). Nothing reads var608, so what the pair is for is unclear.

611.Name: guybrush-voice-pitch
611.Note: Speech frequency of actor 1 (Guybrush): every write is followed by 'actor 1 frequency var611' (371 uses). Normal is 256 (global/script_0001.scumm:51, global/script_0090.scumm:12). The helium balloon raises it to 256 + 340 / 2 (global/script_0089.scumm:86, then "That's made my voice sound funny." at :92) and script 90 slides it back to 256 (global/script_0090.scumm:6-12). The drowsy drink lowers it to 256 - 30/50/100 (rooms/061_hotelbar/local_2025.scumm:94-105).

624.Name: ambient-sounds
624.Note: Array of the sound ids a room has loaded and locked for its ambient sounds. Room scripts do load-sound N, lock-sound N, var624[var625] = N, then start the sound with script 112 (rooms/028_brimbch/local_2003.scumm:10-13 and rooms/028_brimbch/local_2003.scumm:19-22). On room exit, global/script_0012.scumm:24-28 runs unlock-sound var624[var625] for entries 0-20.

625.Name: ambient-sound-count
625.Note: Number of entries in ambient-sounds (var624), and the index of the next one. Room scripts add 1 after each sound and print "ERROR! - Too many ambient sounds" past 20 (rooms/028_brimbch/local_2003.scumm:15-17). global/script_0012.scumm:24-29 loops it from 0 to 20 to unlock them on room exit, then resets it to 0.

630.Name: sentence-verb-text
630.Note: String array holding the verb word of the action sentence on screen. global/script_0039.scumm:166/169 sets it to "/PU_M023/give" or "/PU_M004/use" (var631 gets "to"/"with") and :176/181 blast-text it as "%s{var630} %s{var635} %s{var631} %n{object}". Object scripts set their own verb word in verb 218, e.g. rooms/009_cannon/objects/0281_gaff-object.scumm:48 "/PU_M005/eat" or :50 "talk to".

631.Name: sentence-preposition-text
631.Note: String array holding the preposition of the action sentence on screen, next to sentence-verb-text (var630). global/script_0039.scumm:166-170 sets it to "/PU_M024/to" with give or "/PU_M025/with" with use, and global/script_0039.scumm:176 shows it as "%s{var630} %s{var635} %s{var631} %n{object}". Object scripts set it in verb 219, e.g. rooms/009_cannon/objects/0288_sane-wally-object.scumm:45 and rooms/009_cannon/objects/0288_sane-wally-object.scumm:48.

643.Note: Unconfirmed: looks like an id for Guybrush's current talk/stand animation set. Scripts only ever write it (381 refs, all writes), so if anything reads it, it is the engine. It is set to 47 right after 'do-animation 1 3' when Guybrush's normal look is restored (global/script_0001.scumm:114-115, global/script_0089.scumm:76-77), and global/script_0107.scumm:4-38 and global/script_0109.scumm:8-29 pair each 'actor 1 talk-animation A,B' with one value: (4,5) 47, (15,14) 48, (18,17) 49, (20,19) 50, (24,23) 51, (26,25) 52, (29,28) 53. It is 4 when Guybrush is given a special costume (global/script_0114.scumm:16-18, rooms/071_crakwall/local_2014.scumm:8-10).
